publication.title: A Turiasaurian (Dinosauria, Sauropoda) Tooth from the Pliensbachian Hasle Formation of Bornholm, Denmark, Shows an Early Jurassic Origin of the Turiasauria

locality.name: PBDB collection 223749: at the type section of the Hasle Sandstone south of Hasle harbour, in the southern end of the exposure (N55° 10' 39.369", E14° 42' 9.548"). From a fallen slab, "clearly derived from the succession exposed at the cliff which extends about 1 km from the north to the south."

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 223749 to Early Pliensbachian with numeric bounds 192.9–184.2 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 86968; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 1641776 records Turiasauria in collection 223749, linked by PBDB to reference 86968.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Turiasauria indet. and the accepted name as Turiasauria.
